basics.name: Guillermo Castro
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer | Back-end Development, Cloud Solutions
basics.summary: Java developer with nearly 30 years of experience building and modernizing back-end systems for retail, e-commerce, and education platforms, including Zappos and Cengage Group. Known for Spring Boot, microservices, integrations, and cloud-native delivery across large-scale environments serving millions of users.

work.name: Fusivo LLC
work.summary: Founded Fusivo LLC as a corp-to-corp consulting vehicle for development engagements through Savoir Technologies. Delivered code solutions that improved client systems and processes.

work.name: Zillow
work.summary: Developed and maintained communication services for Zillow’s client messaging platform using Spring Boot, AWS, Terraform. Built a push-notification system for iOS and Android devices that delivers 2 million messages per day. Modernized legacy Spring Boot services. Monitored and supported services with CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, and Databricks.

work.name: Zeitview
work.summary: Developed Spring Boot back-end software for Asset Intelligence & Visualization, reducing manual review time by 15-20% for critical infrastructure inspections. Designed an asset condition scoring system using Spring technologies and contributed through code reviews and pull requests in a remote, standards-driven team environment.

work.name: Savoir Technologies, Inc
work.summary: 15 years of continuous independent consulting, staffed through Savoir Technologies across successive client placements at Cengage Group, Office Depot, Ferguson, Manheim, and Zappos.

work.name: Cengage Group
work.summary: Developed Spring Boot API integrations for internal use and maintained a gateway connecting multiple Learning Management Systems with Cengage Content Systems. Used LTI Advantage and related APIs and third party tools like Auth0 to improve cross-platform interoperability.

work.name: Office Depot, LLC
work.summary: Designed and implemented microservices with Camel and Spring Boot for enterprise integration. Deployed applications across AWS and on-premises environments using Kubernetes, Jenkins, and Rancher, and used Splunk, Dynatrace, and ELK to support troubleshooting and reliability.

work.name: Ferguson
work.summary: Designed and implemented a microservices-oriented REST backend platform for e-commerce applications. Used Docker and OpenShift for continuous development and integration, collaborated with cross-functional teams on feature delivery, and contributed to scalability and performance improvements.

work.name: Ella Paradis
work.summary: Directed a 2-developer external contractor team supporting Magento under MySQL and designed a REST API microservices application for fulfillment, order management, and inventory tracking.

work.name: Manheim
work.summary: Developed and supported multiple backend systems using Apache Camel, Karaf, ActiveMQ, and PostgreSQL.

work.name: Zappos.com
work.summary: Implemented backend systems for Zappos using Spring, established API connections with Stripe and AWS, and supported integration of the proprietary warehouse and inventory system with Amazon’s supply chain and fulfillment infrastructure.

work.name: LeapFrog Enterprises
work.summary: Developed SOA-based services for the Leapfrog Connect application using Spring, Apache CXF, and Mule. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to optimize Oracle PL/SQL queries, improving data retrieval efficiency by 30%.

work.name: H-E-B
work.summary: Designed and developed multiple internal systems using Spring, Struts, JEE, WebSphere, Oracle, and MySQL.

work.name: Softtek
work.summary: Software consulting for Softtek clients in the US, including GE Wind and Citigroup, on-site and remote.

work.name: IIDEA Solutions
work.summary: Designed and implemented ERP applications using .NET, C#, and ASP.NET. Established a robust distributed system authentication infrastructure, ensuring secure access and data integrity. Trained new personnel on software methodologies and programming standards, fostering a culture of excellence.

work.name: FEMSA Comercio
work.summary: Designed and deployed multiple e-commerce platforms utilizing ATG Dynamo Commerce Server and J2EE. Established a standardized development environment with CVS, Ant, and Eclipse to streamline processes. Collaborated with external consultants to enhance project outcomes and ensure timely delivery.

work.name: eMonterrey
work.summary: Designed and implemented an online forum system in PHP. Trained new hires on Object Oriented Programming, Java and UML concepts.

work.name: Dextra Technologies
work.summary: Designed and developed multiple Java based systems for Dextra Technologies clients including Inktomi, Apple, Portal Software, and other companies in the financial and tech market.
